_comment: Codex CLI hooks for compaction-survival. Merge into ~/.codex/hooks.json (the installer does this). Codex exposes the same PreCompact + SessionStart contract as Claude Code (PreCompact added in openai/codex PR #19905), so we snapshot on PreCompact and restore on SessionStart(source=compact). NOTE: Codex's transcript format is explicitly NOT a stable interface, so snapshot capture is best-effort on Codex — restore always works. Fix the command paths to your install dir (single-quote if the path has spaces). Requires jq.
